items.text: Fixed door controllers becoming unpaired when a door is re-skinned, preventing loss of door functionality.

Resolved multiple procedural generation issues: train tunnel entrances no longer lead to the void, stations adjacent to canyons no longer get blocked, and above‑ground ramps correctly connect to the network, improving map connectivity.
Corrected Recycle Bin upgrade drag‑and‑drop behavior so items now swap correctly instead of showing a "Container does not accept player items!" error.
Weapons now show weathering effects such as mud, wetness, snow and wear while held.
Loot is priced by its type; furniture has its own contents and blueprints now have weight.
Supply shop prices increased; every item now has a value and loot drops above crafted gear are more rewarding.
Guards and other enemies drop tier‑based loot; heavy enemies no longer drop the client on death.

Extraction missions refined: hold‑E interactions with movement/camera lock, ledger reads now take 5 seconds and consume repair materials only after completion, and safe‑pocket contents are preserved when loading.
First loot item now appears early and loot reveal UI added for extra clarity.
Extraction balloons are marked on the map with timers and close sequentially.
Safe‑pocket counts toward carried inventory weight and the map is cleared after a raid.
Scout drones patrol small monuments, raise alarms, emit a visible light, can search, have health, and can fire 55‑damage blasts with dodgeable charges and mid‑fight strikes after a 4‑second wind‑up.
Outpost is removed from the raid map.
Hub now has its own markers, no map or death screen on arrival; the hub fridge is a prop and NPC bodies are lootable in the editor.
Monument guards are tiered; weaker factions are placed under the scientists.
The game now refuses to start a raid without a raid map, preventing crashes.
Hotbar now displays action progress and third‑person reloads are aligned.
First‑person weapon shake removed when playing in third‑person view.
Third‑person attack alignment fixed.
Ground vehicles now use a chase camera in third‑person view.
Main inventory size on extraction map reduced by 50%.
Items now display their scrap value, letting players see loot worth.
Extracted loot is automatically banked in a stash; raiders spawn at raid start.
Safe pocket amount shown next to looted items for quick reference.
Reload bar appears beside weapon in shoulder camera for better reload awareness.
Outpost added as a location on the extraction map.
More monuments placed on the extraction map, increasing variety.
New 3 km procedural map scene introduced for extraction raids.
Players can no longer deploy structures while crafting, preventing accidental placement.
First‑person turn‑in‑place rotation bug fixed, eliminating visual pop when rotating.

2026-11-16.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

2026-11-15.summary:

- Mission interactions refined: hold‑E actions now lock movement and camera and cancel cleanly; ledger and maintenance‑log reads take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after completion; safe‑pocket items are preserved when loading before the backpack.

### Drones
- Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.

### Raiding
- Starting a raid without a raid map now simply fails instead of causing an error, preventing crashes.

### NPC & AI
- A new apartment‑complex caretaker NPC patrols the building at night, knocks on rented doors and looks through a peephole.

### Loot & UI
- Mission loot is now revealed to players when earned, and the first loot item appears in inventory without hot‑bar outlines for clearer view.
